title: Vishal:
title_q: “The Myth of the Leader Who Knows Everything”
title_short: Vishal · The Myth of the Leader Who Knows Everything
headline: The myth is that a leader must know all the answers. Most leaders we admire are also winging it, so it's okay to say you don't know.
story: Cold open on the line Atdhe and Nick picked: “Most leaders that we all admire are also winging it.” Then back into the set-up: the myth (you must know all the answers, keep up a facade), why it exists (your team wants to trust you), and the turn: everyone's human.
The hook line plays again where it lands in the story, then the permission: it's okay to say you don't know. It ends on his own summary of the myth.
do: Open on frame 1 on the B cam, already on “Most leaders…”, hook text on screen.

Start the facade line at “You need to have the” (no “that”).
Keep his last line: “And I think that's the myth…”.
dont: No interviewer audio: the question is on-screen text only.
No name plate, logo or fade at 0:00.
No crowded captions and no lime: Brit's caption spec only.
